text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian claims her second crown at the Japanese Derby. While the entire racing world is abuzz, Biwa Hayahide speaks at a press conference for the upcoming Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There, she declares that not only will she win the Takarazuka Kinen, she will eventually compete against her sister.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's more attention on her than ever before. Meanwhile, I gather data on her competition to give her the best chance of success.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I watch footage of the Derby for research and am shocked by the unbelievable speed Narita Brian can put forth. It's no wonder they call her the Beast.
